questions: Do your facial/eye symptoms get worse with repeated use during the day and improve after rest?
Do you have drooping of your eyelid (ptosis) or double vision (diplopia) during the episodes?
During these facial/eye weakness episodes, do you ever notice drooping of your eyelid on one or both sides or worsening when looking up or reading?
During an episode, do you notice any trouble speaking or swallowing (e.g., slurred speech or choking), and does it improve after resting?
During an episode, do you ever have clearly noticeable eyelid drooping (ptosis) on one side or both sides, and does it improve after a short rest or sleeping?
During the episodes, do you have any eyelid drooping (even if mild) or double vision that gets better after lying down or resting for a few minutes?
During an episode, do you get worsening of symptoms after chewing (e.g., eating meat/chewy food) or using your voice?
During an episode, does the facial weakness involve difficulty closing your eyes completely (or does your eyelid seal/getting loose) on one or both sides?
During the facial/eye weakness episodes, do you notice symptoms worsen with sustained eye opening (e.g., staring for 30–60 seconds) and improve shortly after resting?
During an episode, have you had any trouble swallowing liquids or feeling like your voice becomes nasal/weak (bulbar symptoms)?
